title: Harun al-Rashid and the Damsel and Abu Nowas
logline: A sleepless caliph has a secret night encounter, then tests his poet twice: first to put a secret into verse, then, at sword point, to say where a hidden cup has gone. Both times the poet sees through him.
moral: A quick mind and a tactful tongue can turn danger into reward: say what is true without shaming anyone.
tone: Light court comedy: a guilty king, an unshockable poet, a sharp young woman. Suspense is played as a joke the audience is let in on; warm ending.

beats.summary: Harun cannot sleep and wanders his palace.
He uncovers the sleeping woman face and kisses her cheek without asking.
She wakes, startled: the pose the poem will repeat.
Her story: bought for the caliph, kept away by Zubaydah; come back tomorrow.
Abu Nuwas is found in a tavern under a scroll of debts, reciting about a youth clothes.
The first test: a poem about a secret Harun will not tell.
The improvised poem matches the night exactly: WHAT IS THIS?
Harun: it is as if you were there.
A friendly contest of poetry and song.
The woman hides the sleeping poet cup on the caliph order.
The second test, at sword point: where is the cup? Answer in verse.
He names the woman and stops there, sparing her embarrassment.
Laughter, a robe of honour and a thousand dinars; the poet leaves happy.

props.description: The planned lute (AN-087, AN-089): pear body about 90 x 120, short bent-back neck 110 long, 4 string lines, sound hole; anchors for the strumming and fretting hands.

Small stemmed cup, 34 wide x 44 high, yellow with a black outline and a red rim band; options tilt, glint, empty. Also drawn small as an icon.

actions.action: The chamber again, now warm: the two candles (unlit), cushions, the window.
actions.acting: The poet eyes stop on the two candles and the divan for 6 frames (he recognises his own poem).

actions.action: The damsel rises and bows to them.
actions.acting: small tip 0.15, smile, gaze to Harun then to the newcomer.

actions.action: Abu Nuwas sees her: eyes widen, hand to chest, a respectful bow.
actions.acting: eyes wide then lid 0.3, PERSON_HANDS.chest.

actions.action: She turns once; the robe flares.
actions.acting: turnFlip, hem follows with swing.

actions.action: Arrow and label BLUE ROBE; the blue flashes with Ben-Day sparkle.
actions.acting: 2-frame flash, stars.

actions.action: Finger up, then he plucks a line out of the air.
actions.acting: pointUp, lid 1 for 4 frames, then talk.

actions.action: A blue-tinted verse ribbon curls from him around her robe.
actions.acting: Damsel pleased: flush (light), lid 0.3; Harun nods along.

actions.action: Scoreboard tile appears top left: POEMS 1.
actions.acting: Stamps on.

scenes.summary: She answers with the lute and a song. The evening becomes a friendly contest between poetry and singing, with Harun as the delighted judge.

camera.notes: Medium on the damsel (zoom 1.5) for the song; pull out to a three-shot (zoom 1.05) at 112.1 and hold.

scenes.composition: Three-shot: poet seated left (x 230), Harun centre on a cushion (x 500), damsel right on the divan edge (x 760). Scoreboard at the top: POEMS left, SONGS right, well above the heads.

actions.action: She sits, takes the lute and strums.
actions.acting: same strum cycle as S4; gaze on the strings.

actions.action: Notes rise; the poet listens with real admiration.
actions.acting: poet lid 0.5, slow nod; Harun sways.

actions.action: She lifts her chin and sings.
actions.acting: mouth 'open' with talk pulses, lid 0.8, head back 5 px; larger notes with red heads.

actions.action: Scoreboard: SONGS 1.
actions.acting: Stamps on; Harun applauds.

actions.action: Pull out to the three of them.
actions.acting: Eased.

actions.action: Harun in the middle turns his head from one to the other like a tennis spectator.
actions.acting: gazePlan left, right, left; grin.

actions.action: Banner between the scores: POEMS VS SONGS.
actions.acting: Drops in and settles.

actions.action: The poet and the singer bow to each other, smiling.
actions.acting: tip 0.15 each, not in unison (stagger 4 frames).

actions.action: He sends a verse ribbon: POEMS 2.
actions.acting: talk, arm sweep.

actions.action: She answers with a run of notes: SONGS 2. Harun claps over his head.
actions.acting: strum + sing; Harun arms up by angle.

scenes.summary: Late that night, after the drinks, the poet falls asleep still holding his cup. At a sign from the caliph the woman slips it from his fingers and hides it in her sleeve.

camera.notes: Three-shot (zoom 1.1) while the window turns to night; push to zoom 1.7 on the poet hand and the damsel for the theft (125.4 to 127.8); back out to 1.3 at 128.3.

scenes.composition: Poet slumped on cushions at x 240, cup in his right hand resting on his knee at about (290, 800). Harun at x 500. Damsel starts at x 760, tiptoes to x 340. A tray with a jug and two cups at x 620.

actions.action: The window sky slides from dusk to night; the two candles light; a tray with a jug and cups is now on the floor.
actions.acting: skyCycle u 0.5 to 0.72 over 1.5 s; light discs fade in.

actions.action: All three raise their cups; beside the poet a little stack of empty cups counts 1, 2, 3.
actions.acting: poet biggest gesture, lid 0.4; damsel barely lifts hers.

actions.action: His eyelids sink and he sways.
actions.acting: lid 0.3 to 0.75, tip sways 0.05, slow.

actions.action: Head nods down, jerks up once, drops again; Z letters.
actions.acting: head drop 12 px, 2-frame jerk, drop.

actions.action: He slumps sideways onto the cushions, fast asleep; a snore bubble swells and shrinks.
actions.acting: lid 1, mouth 'o' pulsing with breathe, tip -0.3.

actions.action: Arrow to his hand: the cup is still gripped upright. Label STILL HOLDING IT.
actions.acting: Cup tilts 5 degrees with each snore.

actions.action: The cup glints.
actions.acting: One 4-point glint.

actions.action: Harun gets a wicked idea: hush finger, a wink to the damsel, a point at the cup.
actions.acting: wink 'R', smile, PERSON_HANDS.hush then pointFwd.

actions.action: She tiptoes across, biting her lip.
actions.acting: sneak walk 4 steps, gaze fixed on the cup, shoulders up.

actions.action: She eases the cup out of his fingers in three small tugs; he snorts, everyone freezes; he sleeps on, his hand still curled around nothing.
actions.acting: three counted tugs, freeze 5 frames (only pupils move: suspense by stillness).

actions.action: She drops the cup into her wide blue sleeve, which now has a round bump.
actions.acting: quick look left and right, then smooths the sleeve.
actions.library: wineCup + sleeve bulge (ellipse under the sleeve)

actions.action: Arrow from Harun to her: CALIPH ORDER; he nods and rubs his hands.
actions.acting: Harun silent chuckle: shoulders shake, lid 0.7.

actions.action: She sits back in her place, hands folded, looking at the ceiling.
actions.acting: mask on: innocent raised brows, gaze up, tiny smile.

scenes.summary: Harun wakes the poet with a drawn sword and demands, in verse, where the cup is. The joke is frightening; the poet gathers himself and answers with clever lines.

camera.notes: Low two-shot of Harun standing over the seated poet (zoom 1.4). Close on the poet (zoom 2.0) at 136.9. Widen at 137.5 to show the two jokers behind his back; back to the poet at 139.3.

scenes.composition: Poet on the floor at x 260 looking up; Harun stands at x 430, sword raised by arm angle so the blade tip is near (470, 380). Damsel at x 760. The blade never touches or points directly at the poet face: it is held upright or across.

actions.action: Harun stands, sets his face to stern, hand to his belt.
actions.acting: smile wiped to brow 1 (mask on), anticipation dip.

actions.action: Shakes the poet by the shoulder.
actions.acting: two shakes; the poet head lolls.

actions.action: The poet wakes: one eye, then the other, pupils wandering.
actions.acting: wink then both open (wake quietly), mouth 'o', groggy.

actions.action: Harun draws a curved sword in one arc; SHING! and a glint along the blade.
actions.acting: draw = 0.25 s whip with overshoot and settle.

actions.action: The poet sees the blade: eyes huge, he shrinks, trembling.
actions.acting: eyes 'wide', noBlink, sq 0.85, tremble 3 px, shield hands. 3 frames of panel-only shake.

actions.action: Harun thunders his demand.
actions.acting: talk 1, brow 1, free hand palm out.

actions.action: The poet looks down at his own hand: empty, still curled in a cup shape.
actions.acting: gaze down, double take, opens and closes the fingers.

actions.action: Picture balloon from Harun: a map pin and a question mark, WHERE?
actions.acting: Pops on.

actions.action: The cup icon drops into the balloon.
actions.acting: Bounce.

actions.action: IN VERSE! and a verse scroll icon beside the cup.
actions.acting: Poet gulps (drop pulse).

actions.action: Close on the poet: one sweat drop, eyes flicking to the blade.
actions.acting: Only the pupils and the drop move.

actions.action: Wider: behind the poet back, Harun mouth twitches into a grin and the damsel hides a giggle behind her hand. The audience now knows it is a joke.
actions.acting: mask off only while the poet cannot see: PERSON_HANDS.mouthCover, shoulders shake.

actions.action: The sword shadow falls across the poet; Harun snaps stern again as the poet glances up.
actions.acting: shadow = halftone dark band; poet lid flutter, tremble.

actions.action: The poet takes one deep breath and straightens.
actions.acting: sq 1.05 then 1, tremble stops, brow levels.

actions.action: His eyes move in three clean snaps: the caliph mouth, the damsel, her sleeve.
actions.acting: saccades with 5-frame holds.

actions.action: Finger up; he begins to recite.
actions.acting: pointUp, talk 0.8, a small smile returning.

actions.action: A verse ribbon unrolls from him and curls neatly around the raised blade without touching it.
actions.acting: Harun watches it pass, eyebrows rising.

actions.action: Sparkles run along the ribbon: CLEVER!
actions.acting: Stars pop in sequence.

scenes.summary: Abu Nuwas has understood the trick. His verse says, gently, that the woman took the cup and hid it, and he stops there. She brings the cup out herself.

camera.notes: Close on the poet eyes (zoom 2.0) with three small clue insets; pull out to the three-shot (zoom 1.15) at 146.3; small push on the damsel at 153.1.

scenes.composition: Clue insets (r 90) in a row above the poet head at y 330. Then three-shot as S13. The verse ribbon runs from the poet (x 260) in an arc over Harun to end near the damsel (x 760), carrying small icons.

actions.action: Close: the poet eyes narrow, then a slow knowing smile.
actions.acting: lid 0.5, brow 0.3 one side, mouth smile; no light bulb.

actions.action: Clue 1 inset: the caliph hidden grin. A tick.
actions.acting: Iris opens, tick stamps.

actions.action: Clue 2 and 3 insets: the too-innocent face, the bump in the blue sleeve. Label A TRICK!
actions.acting: Two ticks 0.2 s apart.

actions.action: Pull out to all three; Harun still holds the sword up, the damsel still studies the ceiling.
actions.acting: Both hold their masks.

actions.action: The poet recites, hand opening politely toward the damsel (open palm, not a pointing finger).
actions.acting: talk 0.8, courteous half bow.

actions.action: The ribbon reaches her: a small damsel icon on it. She starts and looks at her sleeve.
actions.acting: eyes wide, gaze down to the bump, then to Harun.

actions.action: Next icon on the ribbon: a hand lifting.
actions.acting: Icon pops on its word.

actions.action: Next icon: the cup.
actions.acting: Icon pops; the real sleeve bump glints.

actions.action: Last icon: the cup behind a little drawn curtain, label HIDDEN.
actions.acting: Harun jaw loosens: the mask is slipping.

actions.action: The poet puts a finger to his lips and winks; the rest of the ribbon stays blank and rolls itself up.
actions.acting: wink 'L', PERSON_HANDS.hush, small bow to her.

actions.action: Relieved and laughing, she slides the cup out of her sleeve herself.
actions.acting: flush (light), smile, lid 0.3; the bump disappears as the cup appears.

actions.action: She holds the cup up; it glints. Harun sword arm sinks.
actions.acting: damsel arm up by angle; Harun aR lowers with follow-through.

scenes.summary: Harun roars with laughter, praises the poet quick wit and rewards him: a robe of honour and a thousand dinars.

camera.notes: Three-shot (zoom 1.15) for the laugh; push to 1.5 on the poet for the robe at 160.7 and the coin counter at 161.6.

scenes.composition: Harun centre (x 500), poet left (x 260) now standing, damsel right (x 760). Chamberlain enters from the door (x 150) with a tray. Coin counter top centre at y 250.

actions.action: The mask breaks: Harun throws his head back and laughs; the sword goes back into its sheath.
actions.acting: mouth 'open', lid 0.9, tip -0.12, shoulders shake at 9 Hz.

actions.action: The poet lets out all his breath and sags with relief, then starts laughing too.
actions.acting: sq 0.9 then 1, lid 1 for 6 frames, hand on heart.

actions.action: Harun claps him on the shoulder; the poet bounces.
actions.acting: contact on the word, poet sq 0.92 and a 6 px hop.

actions.action: Speed lines and a spark at the poet head: QUICK WIT!
actions.acting: Spark flickers 3 times.

actions.action: The damsel applauds; the poet bows to her.
actions.acting: clap cycle, smile; poet tip 0.2.

actions.action: Harun claps twice; the chamberlain hurries in with a tray: a folded robe and a sack.
actions.acting: chamberlain walk, careful hands under the tray, eyes on the load.

actions.action: The robe unfurls in a flourish that covers the poet for 6 frames; when it settles he is wearing it (red with gold trim).
actions.acting: Costume change hidden behind the flourish.
actions.library: honourRobe + costume change behind a foreground wipe

actions.action: He admires his new sleeves; label ROBE OF HONOUR.
actions.acting: gaze sleeve to sleeve, proud smile, small turn.

actions.action: The sack opens; coins pour into a pile and the counter races up.
actions.acting: Counter eases 0 to 1000 over 1.1 s; coins arc on seeded paths.

actions.action: Counter lands on 1000 DINARS with a gold glow.
actions.acting: Overshoot to 1.1 scale and settle.

scenes.summary: The poet leaves down the same moonlit corridor, delighted with his escape and his reward. THE END.

camera.notes: Bookend with S1: the corridor strip, tracking left to right with the poet (camX 150 to 650), stopping at 167.0 so that the doorway (left) and the poet (right) are both in frame for the end title.

scenes.composition: Bookend of S1 on the same strip: the lit chamber doorway is at x 600 here (mirror the S1 strip or pass the door x as an option); the poet walks right from x 640 to x 1150 and stops. Harun and the damsel stand small (s 0.8) in the doorway light behind him. THE END title in the upper third (panel y 150 to 330), clear of all heads; moon in the arch above the poet.

actions.action: In the doorway he bows low to them both and backs out into the corridor.
actions.acting: tip 0.3, robe hem swings; Harun waves him off, still chuckling.

actions.action: He walks off along the corridor, coin sack over his shoulder, new robe swishing.
actions.acting: walk with a bounce (amp 1.2), gaze ahead, smile.
actions.library: walk + footfalls + sack carried by handLW

actions.action: A happy skip.
actions.acting: anticipate, hop 40 px, landSquash; coins jingle marks at the sack.

actions.action: He stops, touches his own neck, and blows out his cheeks: PHEW!
actions.acting: gaze back toward the door for a beat, drop pulse, lid 1 for 5 frames.

actions.action: He hugs the sack and gives it a pat.
actions.acting: smile, lid 0.4, pats in two counted beats.

actions.action: THE END title pops. The poet looks at the camera and winks; in the lit doorway behind, Harun and the damsel wave; the moon sits in the arch as at the start.
actions.acting: wink 'R', then idle breathing and blinks to the last frame.

ending.description: After the last word (167.96) the poet stands in the moonlit corridor in his new robe with the coin sack, winks at the camera; Harun and the damsel wave from the lit doorway. THE END title held from 168.3 to 171.25 with idle breathing and blinks.

subtitles.ar: كان هارون الرشيد قلقًا ذات ليلة، فخرج يتمشى في أروقة قصره.|رأى غرفة مضاءة بشمعتين، وفيها فتاة نائمة يغطي شعرها وجهها.|اقترب وكشف وجهها وقبّل خدها دون استئذان،|فاستيقظت مندهشة.
subtitles.en: Restless one night, Harun al-Rashid wandered his palace|and found a sleeping young woman.|He uncovered her face and kissed her without asking;|she woke startled.

subtitles.ar: عزفت الفتاة العود،|وقالت إن ابن الخليفة اشتراها له لكن زبيدة أبعدتها.|وطلبت منه أن يعود في الليلة التالية.
subtitles.en: The young woman played the lute|and said the caliph's son had bought her for him, but Zubaydah had kept her away.|She asked him to return the following night.

subtitles.ar: في الصباح طلب الخليفة أبا نواس،|فوجده الحاجب في حانة|وعليه ديون بسبب إعجابه بشاب.
subtitles.en: In the morning, the caliph sent for Abu Nuwas.|The chamberlain found him in a tavern,|in debt because of his infatuation with a young man.

subtitles.ar: كان أبو نواس يرتجل شعرًا عن ثياب الشاب الملوّنة.|سدد الخليفة دينه ثم استدعاه إلى القصر.
subtitles.en: Abu Nuwas was improvising poems about the young man's colorful clothing.|The caliph paid his debt and summoned him to the palace.

subtitles.ar: قال الخليفة للشاعر: أنشدني قصيدة تتضمن سؤال الفتاة حين استيقظت.|لم يذكر تفاصيل ما جرى،|لكن أبا نواس ارتجل أبياتًا تصف غرفة مظلمة، وشعرًا طويلًا،|وفتاة تستيقظ وتقول مستغربة: ما هذا؟
subtitles.en: Harun asked for lines containing the woman’s surprised question|but gave few details.|Abu Nuwas improvised a scene|strikingly like what had happened.

subtitles.ar: تعجب الخليفة من دقة الوصف، وقال إن الشاعر كأنه كان حاضرًا.|ثم أخذه إلى غرفة الفتاة، فرآها بثوب أزرق، فنظم أبياتًا جديدة.|عزفت الفتاة وغنت أيضًا، وتحول المجلس إلى مسابقة لطيفة بين الشعر والغناء.
subtitles.en: The caliph exclaimed that Abu Nuwas spoke as though he had witnessed the encounter.|They visited the woman,|and poetry and music continued.

subtitles.ar: بعد الشراب غلب النوم أبا نواس وهو يحمل كأسًا.|أخفت الفتاة الكأس بأمر الخليفة،|ثم أيقظه الخليفة بسيف مسلول وطالبه بوصف مكان الكأس في شعره.|كان المزاح مخيفًا، لكن الشاعر أجاب بأبيات حاذقة.
subtitles.en: After drinking, the poet fell asleep holding a cup.|The woman hid it,|and Harun woke him with a drawn sword,|demanding a poetic answer.

subtitles.ar: فهم أبو نواس خدعة المجلس وذكر أن الفتاة أخذت الكأس وأخفته، دون أن يصرح بتفاصيل محرجة.|ضحك الخليفة وأعجب بسرعة بديهته، فأهداه ثوب شرف وألف دينار،|وانصرف الشاعر مسرورًا بنجاته ومكافأته.
subtitles.en: Abu Nuwas cleverly identified the woman as the one who had hidden the cup|without embarrassing her.|Harun rewarded him with a robe and money.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (poet)
new_assets.description: A 'poet' preset on the person costume layer for Abu Nuwas and any court poet or storyteller: green robe, yellow sash, small tilted white turban with a hanging tail, short pointed black beard, quill in the turban.
new_assets.implementation: Add one entry to the presets in cast/people.js built from existing parts (merchant robe, smaller turban ellipse rotated 0.2 rad, tail = tapered quad, beard = short triangle). Quill = a 30 px line with a leaf-shaped vane. Recolour through pal as usual.

new_assets.name: bedchamber
new_assets.description: The planned shared bedchamber (KD-010, KD-022) with an added divan option and candle stands; night, dusk and lamp-lit states.
new_assets.implementation: Compose from towns.js pieces: back wall rect with Ben-Day dots, townDoor arch at the left, townWindow with skyCycle inside, checker floor as in palaceHall. Divan = rounded rect 340 x 80 on four short legs plus a bolster ellipse; blanket = filled path over the lying figure. o.night 0..1 draws a navy multiply-style overlay (globalAlpha) under the candle light discs. Return anchors {door, divan:{x0,x1,top}, window, candles:[..]}.

new_assets.name: palaceHall (night option)
new_assets.description: Planned night lighting for palaceHall (AN-092), used here as a 2000-wide corridor strip with a lit doorway.
new_assets.implementation: palaceHall {w:2000, door:false, u:0.72}: draw skyCycle(0.72) inside each arch, lamps lit with halftone glow, a navy wash at alpha 0.45 over walls and floor, and a yellow trapezoid light wedge on the floor at the doorway.

new_assets.name: oud
new_assets.implementation: Body = ellipse path with a pointed top, brown with yellow face and dot shading; neck = rotated rect; peg box bent back 60 degrees; 4 strings as thin lines; returns {strum:[x,y], fret:[x,y]} in world units for handLW/handRW.

new_assets.name: candle
new_assets.description: Planned candlestick on a floor stand with flicker and light disc.
new_assets.implementation: Stand = thin rect plus two discs; candle = white rect; flame = teardrop path scaled by 1 + 0.08 * K.noise(t * 9 + seed); light disc = radial halftone of yellow dots at alpha 0.5.

new_assets.name: spear, sword
new_assets.description: The planned sword as a scimitar with a sheath and a glint.
new_assets.implementation: Blade = two quadratic curves closing a crescent 150 long, white with a black outline; hilt = yellow cross bar and grip; glint = 4-point star sliding along the blade over 0.3 s. Drawn in the hand at the angle of the forearm.

new_assets.name: wineCup
new_assets.description: Small stemmed cup, also usable as an icon; tilt, glint and empty options.
new_assets.implementation: Bowl = half ellipse, stem = rect, foot = ellipse; yellow fill, black outline, red rim band; rotate about the stem for tilt.

new_assets.name: coinPile, purse, foodTray, necklace, scroll
new_assets.description: Planned small props reused under their planned names: coinPile (with a running counter), purse (with seal), scroll (debt scroll that unrolls, verse scroll icon), tray.
new_assets.implementation: coinPile = stacked yellow ellipses on seeded positions revealed by a count; purse = pear path with a drawstring; scroll = rect whose length is a parameter with a rolled end (two circles) and red tally lines every 24 px.

new_assets.name: honourRobe
new_assets.description: Robe of honour: folded on a tray, then an unfurling cloth flourish that hides the costume change.
new_assets.implementation: Folded = red rounded rect with a yellow border. Flourish = a 260 x 300 path whose lower edge is a sine wave, scaled from 0.2 to 1 over 6 frames in front of the figure, then removed while the figure pal switches to red with yellow trim.

new_assets.name: person hairVeil
new_assets.description: Opt-in long loose hair on the maiden/lady presets: hair 0..1 drawn down past the shoulders, and hairVeil 0..1 sweeping it across the face (for sleeping or grieving figures).
new_assets.implementation: A black filled path from the crown down one side of the head to shoulder height (lie pose: along the pillow); hairVeil interpolates the front edge control points from beside the face to across it; 3 strand tips offset by a breathe value. Drawn after the face. Default 0 keeps every existing drawing identical.

new_assets.name: person youth option
new_assets.description: Planned youth:true (AN-086): no facial hair, head 1.1x, s about 0.84; used for the young man.
new_assets.implementation: As planned by AN-086: a flag in people.js that suppresses beard and moustache and scales the head.

new_assets.name: person laugh
new_assets.description: Planned laugh helper (AN-084, AN-092) for Harun at 155.06.
new_assets.implementation: Helper returning {mouth:'open', lid:0.9, tip:-0.12} plus a 9 Hz 2 px shoulder shake from Math.sin(t).

new_assets.name: sneak
new_assets.description: Planned tiptoe option for walk(): high knees and a short hold on each toe. Harun at 17.6 and the damsel at 125.4.
new_assets.implementation: walk(X, t, {sneak:true}): X is a stepped position function (ease, hold) and the lifted knee amplitude is 1.6x; footfalls from the same steps.

new_assets.name: flush
new_assets.description: Planned flush, used lightly for the damsel (107.0 and 153.1) as a pleased blush: two red dot patches on the cheeks, no steam.
new_assets.implementation: Two clipped circles of red Ben-Day dots on the cheeks with alpha from the field value.

new_assets.name: musicNotes
new_assets.description: Planned rising quavers from the lute (S4, S12).
new_assets.implementation: n calls of the Library note() on seeded S-paths from the sound hole, rocking by sin and fading over 1.2 s.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon, strip mode for the damsel story (S4) and single mode for orders and questions (S3, S5, S7, S8, S14).
new_assets.implementation: Rounded white box with a tail and a black outline, a clip region, and a callback that draws small figures and icons in local units, as thoughtCloud does.

new_assets.name: verseRibbon
new_assets.description: Poetry made visible: a paper band with squiggle lines of writing that unrolls from the poet along a curve, can carry small icons, curl round an object and roll up again. The visual counterpart of musicNotes.
new_assets.implementation: A polyline sampled from a cubic path from 0 to u (growth 0..1), drawn as a 26 px wide paper stroke over a 32 px black stroke; writing = short black dashes along the centre line; icons placed at given path fractions and popped on their cue times; roll-up = shrink u from the tail with a small spiral at the end.

new_assets.name: inset circle
new_assets.description: Planned round picture-in-picture with an iris: the poem versus last night (93.5) and the three clues (144.8).
new_assets.implementation: Clip to a circle growing from r 0 with overshoot, draw the given scene at a scale, black ring 8 px; with the planned dream wash for the memory.

new_assets.name: goldGlow
new_assets.description: Planned gold glow behind the 1000 DINARS counter.
new_assets.implementation: Radial rays of yellow wedges at alpha 0.6 rotating slowly, behind the counter.

owner_questions: The kiss "without asking" (20.2) is shown as one quick comic peck on the cheek with MWAH! and a crossed-out question balloon; default: shown this way, light and brief, not romantic.
The tavern, wine cups and "after drinking" are shown plainly (cups, a jug, a stack of empty cups, the poet dozing) with no staggering; default: shown.
The poet's infatuation with the young man (50.96) is staged as admiring verses about his clothes plus one small heart; default: one heart, nothing more.
The script does not say where the cup is hidden; default: the damsel drops it into her wide blue sleeve, and brings it out herself at 153.1.
The damsel being "bought" (32.68) is shown only as small icons (a purse changing hands) in her picture balloon; default: shown as icons.
Zubaydah appears only as a small stern figure inside the picture balloon, labelled ZUBAYDAH; default: shown.
The sword joke is softened: the blade is held upright or across and never points at a face, and at 137.56 the audience sees Harun and the damsel hiding smiles; default: softened this way.

Invented English lettering beyond the script: MWAH!, WHO?, ?!, BOUGHT, FOR YOU, TOMORROW NIGHT, BRING ME..., DEBTS, PAID!, A POEM!, SECRET, CLUES: 2, LONG HAIR, WHAT IS THIS?!, SAME!, WERE YOU THERE?!, BLUE ROBE, POEMS VS SONGS, STILL HOLDING IT, CALIPH ORDER, SHING!, WHERE?, IN VERSE!, CLEVER!, A TRICK!, HIDDEN, HA HA HA!, QUICK WIT!, ROBE OF HONOUR, 1000 DINARS, PHEW!; default: all used (about 30, trim in review if it feels busy).
Spelling in labels follows the English subtitles (ABU NUWAS) although the story title says Abu Nowas; default: ABU NUWAS.
The film ends with an added bookend (the poet winks at the camera in the corridor, Harun and the damsel wave); default: included, 3.0 s hold.
implementation_notes: Cue everything with w(p, n) from timing.json; the times in this plan are the word starts in planning/inputs/timeline.md. Paragraph gaps are short, so scene cuts sit on the first word of the next sentence.

Humans are all person(): harun {costume:'caliph', age:0.5}, damsel {costume:'maiden'} (blue pal from S11), abuNowas {costume:'poet'} (new preset), chamberlain {costume:'vizier', pal green/white, hold:'stick'}, youth {costume:'prince', youth:true, multicolour pal, no crown via pal/headwear option}, keeper {costume:'merchant', pal brown}.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame for automatic blinks; give explicit lid values for sleep (lid 1), the waking snap (23.6) and all held shocks (noBlink).

Setup and payoff: store the damsel waking pose keys of 23.6-25.8 (sit-up, hands to cheeks, mouth o) in one function and call it again inside the poem cloud at 86.36-88.8 at scale 0.5. The match is the joke of the film.
The poem cloud is thoughtCloud with o.inside drawing the bedchamber function at scale 0.5 (o.at on the divan). Keep the cloud figure at least 110 px tall on screen.
Mask on / mask off for Harun and the damsel in S13-S15: grins only while the poet eyes are shut or turned away; snap back to stern or innocent within 3 frames when he looks.

Lying figure: person {lie:1} has its origin under the hips with the head toward -x; put the divan head end at the left so her face is near Harun. Draw the blanket and the hairVeil over the figure in the scene.
Seats: Harun on the throne uses sit:1, seat:'bench' at the palaceHall throne anchor; floor sitters use seat:'floor'; the damsel on the divan edge uses seat:'bench' with y at the divan top.

Big arm shapes (sword raised, cup raised, clapping overhead, reciting sweep) use aL/aR angles so they read at phone size; hand targets (handLW/handRW) are for touching props: hair, lute, cup, sleeve, purse.

Camera: build two-shots with twoShot(a, b, {margin}); apply shake inside the panel clip only (24.84, 131.68). Hide the scene change at 40.7 under the LATER card (camera key pair 0.01 s apart at p 0.5).

Sound: only the listed effects, all in measured pauses: 29.65, 40.7, 45.42, 53.0, 67.8, 73.27, 91.2, 136.6, 162.6, 168.15. SND master 0.6. SHING!, MWAH! and HA HA HA! are lettering only because there is no gap under them.
Lettering never covers a face; score tiles and the coin counter stay above y 300 in panel terms. No en or em dashes in any on-screen text.

Set coordinates in this plan (divan, candles, counter, door) are design targets for the new or dressed sets; for palaceHall read the returned anchors (throne, door) instead of the approximate numbers.
After adding the poet preset, hairVeil, youth and the props to Library, run node Library/tests/regression.mjs (must report all identical) and rebuild the catalogue.
warnings: The English subtitle text is a condensed translation: it omits details that the Arabic narrates (the two candles and hair in P1, the dark room, long hair and WHAT IS THIS? in P5, the blue robe and the contest in P6, the frightening joke in P7, the laughter, the thousand dinars and the departure in P8). Both are kept verbatim; the picture follows the Arabic.
Because the English is shorter, its chunks do not always line up with what the Arabic chunk says at that moment (notably P5 and P6).
S9 (14.3 s) depends on the poem cloud reading clearly on a phone: keep it large (640 x 430) and uncluttered.
About 30 pieces of lettering is above the usual lettering diet (8 to 12); counters and labels carry much of the court intrigue, but trim in review if busy.
Mature themes (an uninvited kiss, wine, a purchased woman, infatuation) are staged lightly; see owner_questions.
A single LATER card is used (40.7, NEXT MORNING...); the later time jumps (the evening visit at 99.6, after the drinks at 117.88) use a wipe and a dissolve with the window sky changing.
